name: Dajudali
description: The New Year brings good news and cute rabbits are coming. Pinku uses the "rabbit" in the Chinese zodiac as the creative source to create the metal puzzle "Rabbit and Rabbit Couple", giving traditional customs a new way to play. The "Rabbit and Rabbit Couple" is full of persimmon and orange elements, which means everything goes well and good luck. Colored lamp beads can also be placed inside to turn into interesting lanterns. Let’s fight for the “Rabbit and Rabbit Alliance” in the new year and start the new year hardcore together!
